display.purpose: Page and section titles across all five dashboards.

label.purpose: Form labels, table headers, badge text.

shadows.name: resting-card
shadows.purpose: Default card at rest; intensifies to shadow-md on hover.

shadows.name: floating-panel
shadows.purpose: Map, seat-map, modals: surfaces that float above the page grid.

shadows.name: inset-seat
shadows.purpose: Seat buttons and vehicle chassis body.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: Live/real-time indicator halo. Falls back to static filled dot under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action across all dashboards (confirm booking, issue fine, approve sacco).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #068930; color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,24,36,0.05); transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #045A20; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(18,24,36,0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #068930; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Tinted status badge (10% bg + full-opacity text); used for ACTIVE/FLAGGED/PENDING across matatus, fines, bookings, reports.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-badge-active { background: rgba(6,137,48,0.1); color: #068930; } .ds-badge-flagged { background: rgba(252,221,7,0.15); color: #806a00; } .ds-badge-alert { background: rgba(206,17,38,0.1); color: #CE1126; }

components.name: Live Indicator
components.description: Cross-dashboard 'this is happening right now' signal: pulsing dot + label. Used on GisMap, crew GPS toggle.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #FCDD07; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-live-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #068930; position: relative; } .ds-live-dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #068930; animation: ds-ping 1.5s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(2); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-live-dot::after { animation: none; display: none; } }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content surface: white on county-cream background.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(18,24,36,0.05); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,24,36,0.05); padding: 20px; transition: box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(18,24,36,0.1); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active/inactive nav link in the county-black sidebar, with a yellow left-edge marker on the active item.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: block; position: relative; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #068930; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2px; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: #FCDD07; }

narrative.overview: Two things are true about a matatu corridor at once: it's an official, licensed transit artery run by county government, and it's a living stretch of Nairobi street culture. This system is built the same way: two-thirds institutional (county-black, county-green, cream), one-third matatu energy (county-yellow as a live signal, livery accents in named slots).
keyCharacteristics: County-black as the institutional anchor color
County-yellow reserved for live state and singular emphasis
Matatu livery accents live in named slots only: empty states, live indicators, vehicle cards, loading states
Flat, tonal surfaces at rest; elevation only for floating panels (map, seat chart, modals)

rules.name: The Yellow Discipline Rule
rules.body: County-yellow signals 'live' or 'act now' and nothing else.

rules.name: The Two-Thirds Rule
rules.body: Any screen should read as roughly two-thirds institutional, at most one-third yellow/blue/livery accent.

rules.name: The One Mono Rule
rules.body: font-mono is reserved for plate numbers, ticket IDs, and coordinates.

rules.name: The Float Justifies Depth Rule
rules.body: A shadow's size should match how far above the page the element conceptually sits.

dos: Do use county-black as the base for any instrument-panel surface (map, seat chart, telemetry bar).
Do reserve county-yellow for genuinely live or actionable moments.
Do apply the same live-indicator pattern identically across all five dashboards.
Do use livery/matatu accents only in named slots: empty states, vehicle cards, live badges, loading states.
Do keep data-dense surfaces closer to flat county-black-on-cream with minimal color noise.
donts: Don't ship a generic corporate SaaS dashboard with no Nairobi identity.
Don't replicate a dated 2010s government portal look.
Don't let matatu graffiti/livery motifs become kitsch or decorate data-dense surfaces.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe except the sidebar's active-nav marker.
Don't use county-yellow as a large background fill or default button color.
Don't convey status by color alone; always pair with a text label.
